"""Independent local landing CLI controls under the already fixed protocol."""
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

def drive(source,output):
    here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fixed_fixture',here/'fixture.py')
    fixture=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(fixture)
    output=Path(output).resolve();output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    records=[]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='comparison-local-landing-') as folder:
        for case in ('ordinary','admitted','rejected','foreign_subject','weak_target','raw_tamper'):
            outer=Path(folder)/case;control=outer/'control';control.mkdir(parents=True)
            value=fixture.build(source,control/'.worktrees/fixture',case)
            root=Path(value['root']);issue=json.loads(Path(value['issue']).read_text())
            contract=json.loads(issue['body'].split('```json\n')[1].split('\n```')[0])
            envelope={'schema':1,'repository':'ed3c/soodles','issue':1,
                      'body_sha256':fixture.sha(issue['body'].encode()),'body_updated_at':issue['updated_at'],
                      'owner':contract['owner'],'write_paths':contract['write_paths'],'base_head':value['base'],
                      'execution':{'control_root':str(control),'worktree':'fixture','order_id':'soodles-1',
                                   'stage_index':0,'carrier':{'fixture':True},'task':'Bounded synthetic landing control.','source_head':value['base']}}
            envelope_path=outer/'envelope.json';envelope_path.write_bytes(fixture.encoded(envelope))
            cli=[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'soodles.py')]
            identity=subprocess.run(cli+['landing','identity'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
            verifier=json.loads(identity.stdout)['verifier_sha256']
            head=value['head'];base=value['base'];tree=fixture.git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')
            claim={'repository':'ed3c/soodles','issue':1,'pr':2,'head':head,'tree':tree,'base_head':base,
                   'run_id':10,'run_attempt':1,'worktree':'fixture','control_root':str(control),
                   'verifier_sha256':verifier,'execution_envelope':{'path':str(envelope_path),'sha256':fixture.sha(envelope_path.read_bytes())}}
            repo={'full_name':'ed3c/soodles'}
            snapshot={'issue':issue,
                      'pr':{'number':2,'html_url':'https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/pull/2','body':'Refs ed3c/soodles#1',
                            'head':{'repo':repo,'sha':head,'ref':'fixture'},'base':{'repo':repo,'sha':base,'ref':'main'},
                            'state':'open','draft':False,'merged':False,'mergeable':True},
                      'run':{'id':10,'run_attempt':1,'repository':repo,'head_repository':repo,'head_sha':head,
                             'event':'pull_request','path':'.github/workflows/runtime.yml','status':'completed','conclusion':'success'},
                      'commit':{'sha':head,'tree':{'sha':tree}},'branch':{'name':'main','commit':{'sha':base}},
                      'jobs':{'total_count':1,'jobs':[{'id':11,'name':'runtime-evidence','run_id':10,'head_sha':head,
                                                    'status':'completed','conclusion':'success',
                                                    'steps':[{'name':'Canonical acceptance on the exact candidate head','status':'completed','conclusion':'success'}]}]}}
            cp=outer/'checkpoint.json';claim_path=outer/'claim.json';readback=outer/'readback.json'
            claim_path.write_bytes(fixture.encoded(claim));readback.write_bytes(fixture.encoded(snapshot))
            events=[]
            for operation in ('start','advance','dispatch'):
                args=[str(claim_path),str(readback),str(cp)] if operation=='start' else [str(cp),str(readback)]
                argv=cli+['landing',operation]+args
                p=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
                try:d=json.loads(p.stdout)
                except ValueError:d={}
                events.append({'argv':argv,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
                if p.returncode:break
            request=any('request' in json.loads(e['stdout']) for e in events if e['stdout'].startswith('{'))
            positive=case in ('ordinary','admitted')
            ok=(len(events)==3 and all(e['exit']==0 for e in events) and request) if positive else (events[-1]['exit']!=0 and not request)
            records.append({'case':case,'events':events,'merge_request_created':request,'provider_transport_count':0,
                            'predicate':'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL','snapshot_is_synthetic':True})
    receipt={'classification':'GREEN' if all(r['predicate']=='PASS' for r in records) else 'RED','records':records,
             'scope':'direct local landing CLI with synthetic provider/envelope; no real Noodle or provider effects','authorizes_landing':False}
    (output/'receipt.json').write_bytes(fixture.encoded(receipt))
    print(json.dumps({'classification':receipt['classification'],'cases':{r['case']:r['predicate'] for r in records}}))
    return 0 if receipt['classification']=='GREEN' else 1
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(drive(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]))
